objective: Correct maintainable work with less human supervision and rework; automated behavioral acceptance is only one gate.
human_metrics: Actual acceptance, specifying/supervising/review/rework/verification minutes, interventions and request-to-acceptance elapsed time require human records; unknown is null, never inferred from calls.
diagnostics: diagnostic to decision to artifact to accepted outcome
stop_rules: Freeze hashes and validate gold, originals and incomplete controls before calls
Stop on infrastructure or containment failure; retain every attempt
If baseline saturates or no meaningful paired outcome difference, stop without promotion
Repeat baseline and finalist only for a new accepted task with preserved gates or at least 20% lower sample elapsed time without acceptance loss; confirm on untouched holdout before adoption
Expand toward 20-30 independent repository cases only after calibration exposes useful variation; do not count clean and defective review as independent families
adoption: No installed/global skill change from calibration. Human acceptance and maintenance cost remain required for productivity claims. Small ties are inconclusive, not equivalence.
uncertainty: Report paired case and family outcomes; with few families do not claim precise population intervals. Repeated finalists measure consistency, not additional independent tasks.
ablations: Compact output and path-focused navigation only after traces identify a bottleneck; not part of this pilot.
provenance: Local controlled Python repositories, no imported public tasks. Audit any future import for revision/license, prompt-test agreement, gold validity, incomplete repairs, leakage and dependencies before execution.
